ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.notes: divided; 1 tablespoon is for tossing with pasta

ingredients.name: ground beef chuck
ingredients.notes: or 1 part pork to 2 parts beef

ingredients.name: canned imported Italian plum tomatoes with juice

steps.text: Put the oil, 3 tablespoons butter and onion in a pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring, until the onion is translucent. Add celery and carrot and cook for about 2 minutes, stirring to coat.
Add the beef, a large pinch of salt and a few grindings of pepper. Crumble with a fork and cook until the beef has lost its raw red color.
Add milk and simmer gently, stirring frequently, until it has bubbled away completely. Stir in about 1/8 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg.

Add wine and simmer until evaporated. Add tomatoes and stir thoroughly. Once bubbling, reduce heat to the laziest simmer and cook uncovered for 3 hours or more, stirring occasionally. Add 1/2 cup water whenever needed to prevent sticking; at the end no water should remain and the fat should separate. Stir, taste and correct the salt.
Toss the sauce with cooked, drained pasta and the remaining tablespoon butter. Serve with freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.
